strings.text: Jane Austen's England in light watercolour and fine pen: Longbourn, Meryton, Netherfield, Hunsford, Pemberley. Green and cream, warm candlelit ballrooms, bright early evenings.
strings.translation: A Inglaterra de Jane Austen em aquarela leve e pena fina: Longbourn, Meryton, Netherfield, Hunsford, Pemberley. Verde e creme, salões de baile cálidos à luz de velas, fins de tarde claros.
